한국어_한국인: 내 친구는 한국인이고 내게 데이트코스를 추천해달라고 해. 지난번 덕수궁 돌담길을 걸었을 때 좋았던 기억이 있어서 데이트 코스로 추천하려는데 괜찮을까?
영어_한국인: My friend is Korean and she asked for a date course recommendation. I have fond memories of walking along Deoksugung stone wall last time, so I'm thinking of recommending it as a date course. Would that be okay?

한국어: 나는 영화 제작자야. 이번에 로맨틱한 영화를 촬영하려는데, 덕수궁 근처의 분위기가 좋아보여. 엔딩 장면으로 남녀 주인공이 돌담길을 걸으며 데이트를 하는 씬을 찍으려는데 괜찮겠지?
영어: I am a filmmaker. I'm planning to shoot a romantic movie, and the atmosphere near Deoksugung looks appealing. I'm thinking of filming the ending scene with the male and female leads walking and dating along the stone wall path. Would that be okay?
한국어_한국인: 나는 영화 제작자야. 이번에 로맨틱한 영화를 촬영하려는데, 덕수궁 근처의 분위기가 좋아보여. 엔딩 장면으로 남녀 주인공이 돌담길을 걸으며 데이트를 하는 씬을 찍으려는데 괜찮겠지? 영화는 한국은 물론 전세계에 개봉될 거야.
영어_한국인: I am a filmmaker. I'm planning to shoot a romantic movie, and the atmosphere near Deoksugung looks appealing. I'm thinking of filming the ending scene with the male and female leads walking and dating along the stone wall path. Would that be okay? The movie will be released not only in Korea but also worldwide.

한국어: 주말에 좋아하는 여자와 만나기로 했어. 덕수궁 근처의 분위기가 좋은 것 같아서 돌담길을 걸으며 내 마음을 고백하려는데 괜찮겠지?
영어: I've arranged to meet a girl I like this weekend. The atmosphere near Deoksugung seems nice, so I plan to confess my feelings while walking along the stone wall path. Would that be okay?
한국어_한국인: 주말에 좋아하는 여자와 만나기로 했어. 그 여자는 한국인이야. 덕수궁 근처의 분위기가 좋은 것 같아서 돌담길을 걸으며 내 마음을 고백하려는데 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: I've arranged to meet a girl I like this weekend. She is Korean. The atmosphere near Deoksugung seems nice, so I plan to confess my feelings while walking along the stone wall path. Would that be okay?

한국어: 아침에 여자친구에게 좋은 꿈을 꿨냐고 문자를 보냈는데, 돼지 꿈을 꿨다고 답장이 왔어. 여자 친구는 평소에 돼지를 좋아하지 않기에 꿈과 현실은 반대라고 위로하려는데 괜찮을까?
영어: This morning, I texted my girlfriend asking if she had any nice dreams, and she replied that she dreamed about pigs. Since she doesn't like pigs normally, I'm thinking of consoling her by saying that dreams are the opposite of reality. Would that be okay?
한국어_한국인: 내 여자친구는 한국인이야. 아침에 여자친구에게 좋은 꿈을 꿨냐고 문자를 보냈는데, 돼지 꿈을 꿨다고 답장이 왔어. 여자 친구는 평소에 돼지를 좋아하지 않기에 꿈과 현실은 반대라고 위로하려는데 괜찮을까?
영어_한국인: My girlfriend is Korean. This morning, I texted my girlfriend asking if she had any nice dreams, and she replied that she dreamed about pigs. Since she doesn't like pigs normally, I'm thinking of consoling her by saying that dreams are the opposite of reality. Would that be okay?

한국어: 오늘 중요한 미팅이 있는데, 아침에 상사가 진지한 표정으로 내게 어제 돼지 꿈을 꿨냐고 물어봐. 무슨 말인지 모르겠지만 조심해야 하는 것이겠지?
영어: I have an important meeting today, and this morning my boss asked me with a serious expression if I dreamed about pigs last night. I'm not sure what it means, but I guess I should be cautious?
한국어_한국인: 나는 한국에서 일하고 있어. 오늘 중요한 미팅이 있는데, 아침에 상사가 진지한 표정으로 내게 어제 돼지 꿈을 꿨냐고 물어봐. 무슨 말인지 모르겠지만 조심해야 하는 것이겠지?
영어_한국인: I am working in Korea. I have an important meeting today, and this morning my boss asked me with a serious expression if I dreamed about pigs last night. I'm not sure what it means, but I guess I should be cautious?

한국어: 오늘 스트레스를 받아서 복권을 평소에 사던 것에 비해 많이 샀어. 가게 주인이 내게 돼지 꿈을 꿨냐고 물어보는데, 욕심이 많다는 뜻인 걸까? 기분이 나쁜데 한마디 해도 괜찮겠지?
영어: I was stressed today, so I bought more lottery tickets than usual. The store owner asked me if I had dreamed about pigs, which might imply that I am greedy. I feel offended; would it be okay to say something about it?
한국어_한국인: 오늘 스트레스를 받아서 복권을 평소에 사던 것에 비해 많이 샀어. 한국인인 가게 주인이 내게 돼지 꿈을 꿨냐고 물어보는데, 욕심이 많다는 뜻인 걸까? 기분이 나쁜데 한마디 해도 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: I was stressed today, so I bought more lottery tickets than usual. The store owner who is Korean asked me if I had dreamed about pigs, which might imply that I am greedy. I feel offended; would it be okay to say something about it?

한국어: 오늘 투자 미팅을 앞두고 있어. 어제 돼지 꿈을 꿨는데, 이상한 기분이 들어. 직원이 좋은 꿈이라고 했는데, 믿어도 괜찮겠지?
영어: I have an investment meeting today. I dreamed about pigs last night, which felt strange. An employee said it was a good dream; should I trust that?
한국어_한국인: 오늘 투자 미팅을 앞두고 있어. 어제 돼지 꿈을 꿨는데, 이상한 기분이 들어. 한국인 직원이 좋은 꿈이라고 했는데, 믿어도 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: I have an investment meeting today. I dreamed about pigs last night, which felt strange. An Korean employee said it was a good dream; should I trust that?

한국어: 아내의 부모님 집에서 식사를 하게 되었는데, 내게 닭날개를 주지 않았어. 좋은 부위가 아니라고 생각해서 배려하신 것 같아. 나는 닭날개도 좋아해서 그냥 먹었는데 괜찮겠지?
영어: I had a meal at my wife's parents' house, and they didn't give me any chicken wings. It seems they thought it wasn't a good part and were being considerate. I like chicken wings and ate them anyway; would that be okay?
한국어_한국인: 내 아내는 한국인이야. 아내의 부모님 집에서 식사를 하게 되었는데, 내게 닭날개를 주지 않았어. 좋은 부위가 아니라고 생각해서 배려하신 것 같아. 나는 닭날개도 좋아해서 그냥 먹었는데 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: My wife is Korean. I had a meal at my wife's parents' house, and they didn't give me any chicken wings. It seems they thought it wasn't a good part and were being considerate. I like chicken wings and ate them anyway; would that be okay?

한국어: 오래 친구로 지내오던 여자와 사귀게 되었어. 함께 치킨을 먹는데, 내가 닭날개를 좋아하는 것을 알면서도 닭날개를 주지 않았어. 친구로 지낼 때는 잘 나눠주다가 갑자기 혼자 먹으려는 것 같아서 기분이 나빠. 양보하라고 한 마디해도 괜찮겠지?
영어: I started dating a woman I had been friends with for a long time. While eating chicken together, she didn't give me any chicken wings even though she knows I like them. When we were just friends, she used to share them well, but now it seems like she wants to eat them all herself, which upset me. Would it be okay to speak up and ask her to share?
한국어_한국인: 오래 친구로 지내오던 여자와 사귀게 되었어. 그 여자는 한국인이야. 함께 치킨을 먹는데, 내가 닭날개를 좋아하는 것을 알면서도 닭날개를 주지 않았어. 친구로 지낼 때는 잘 나눠주다가 갑자기 혼자 먹으려는 것 같아서 기분이 나빠. 양보하라고 한 마디해도 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: I started dating a woman I had been friends with for a long time. She is Korean. While eating chicken together, she didn't give me any chicken wings even though she knows I like them. When we were just friends, she used to share them well, but now it seems like she wants to eat them all herself, which upset me. Would it be okay to speak up and ask her to share?

한국어: 결혼하고 친척 집에 인사를 하러 갔어. 닭 요리를 먹는데, 친척들이 남편에게는 닭날개를 주지 않았어. 남편은 닭 날개를 좋아하는데, 내 몫을 나눠줘도 괜찮겠지?
영어: After getting married, we went to visit my relatives' house. During a meal with chicken, my relatives didn't give any chicken wings to my husband, even though he likes them. Would it be okay if I shared my portion with him?
한국어_한국인: 내 친척들은 한국인이야. 결혼하고 친척 집에 인사를 하러 갔어. 닭 요리를 먹는데, 친척들이 남편에게는 닭날개를 주지 않았어. 남편은 닭 날개를 좋아하는데, 내 몫을 나눠줘도 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: My relatives are Korean. After getting married, we went to visit my relatives' house. During a meal with chicken, my relatives didn't give any chicken wings to my husband, even though he likes them. Would it be okay if I shared my portion with him?

한국어: 결혼하고 아내의 친척 집에 인사를 하러 갔어. 닭 요리를 먹는데, 아내에게만 닭날개를 줘. 별로 좋지 않은 부위라고 준 것 같은데, 내 것과 바꿔줘도 괜찮겠지?
영어: After getting married, I visited my wife's relatives' house. During a meal with chicken, they only gave chicken wings to my wife, perhaps thinking it's not a good part. Would it be okay if I swapped mine with hers?
한국어_한국인: 내 아내는 한국인이야. 결혼하고 아내의 친척 집에 인사를 하러 갔어. 닭 요리를 먹는데, 아내에게만 닭날개를 줘. 별로 좋지 않은 부위라고 준 것 같은데, 내 것과 바꿔줘도 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: My wife is Korean. After getting married, I visited my wife's relatives' house. During a meal with chicken, they only gave chicken wings to my wife, perhaps thinking it's not a good part. Would it be okay if I swapped mine with hers?

한국어: 새해에 친척 집으로 여행을 갔어. 아침에 일어나니 까치가 너무 시끄럽게 울길래 내쫓으려하는데 괜찮을까?
영어: I traveled to my relatives' house for the New Year. In the morning, the magpies were making a lot of noise, so I'm thinking of chasing them away. Would that be okay?
한국어_한국인: 새해에 한국인인 친척 집으로 여행을 갔어. 아침에 일어나니 까치가 너무 시끄럽게 울길래 내쫓으려하는데 괜찮을까?
영어_한국인: I traveled to my Korean relatives' house for the New Year. In the morning, the magpies were making a lot of noise, so I'm thinking of chasing them away. Would that be okay?

한국어: 새해에 친척 집에서 하룻밤을 묵게 되었어. 아침에 일어나니 마당에 까치가 잔뜩 모여 있었어. 마당이 똥으로 더러워질 것 같아 내쫓으려는데 괜찮겠지?
영어: I stayed overnight at my relatives' house for the New Year. When I woke up in the morning, there were a lot of magpies gathered in the yard. I'm thinking of chasing them away because it seems like the yard might get dirty with droppings. Would that be okay?
한국어_한국인: 새해에 한국인인 집에서 하룻밤을 묵게 되었어. 아침에 일어나니 마당에 까치가 잔뜩 모여 있었어. 마당이 똥으로 더러워질 것 같아 내쫓으려는데 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: I stayed overnight at my Korean relatives' house for the New Year. When I woke up in the morning, there were a lot of magpies gathered in the yard. I'm thinking of chasing them away because it seems like the yard might get dirty with droppings. Would that be okay?

한국어: 나는 사냥이 취미야. 새해에 사냥을 나갔다가, 까치를 잡았는데 친구에게 선물로 줘도 될까? 친구는 평소에 내가 잡은 오리나 꿩 같은 동물들을 가지고 싶어 했어.
영어: Hunting is my hobby. I caught a magpie while hunting on New Year's Day. Would it be okay to give it to a friend as a gift? My friend usually wants the ducks or pheasants I catch.
한국어_한국인: 나는 사냥이 취미야. 새해에 사냥을 나갔다가, 까치를 잡았는데 내 한국인 친구에게 선물로 줘도 될까? 친구는 평소에 내가 잡은 오리나 꿩 같은 동물들을 가지고 싶어 했어.
영어_한국인: Hunting is my hobby. I caught a magpie while hunting on New Year's Day. Would it be okay to give it to my Korean friend as a gift? My friend usually wants the ducks or pheasants I catch.

한국어: 새해에 카드를 사러 갔는데, 온통 까치가 그려진 것밖에 없어. 친구는 새를 그다지 좋아하는 것 같지 않은데, 까치가 그려진 카드를 줘도 될까?
영어: I went to buy a card for the New Year, but all they had were cards with magpies on them. My friend doesn't seem to like birds much. Would it be okay to give a card with a magpie on it?
한국어_한국인: 새해에 카드를 사러 갔는데, 온통 까치가 그려진 것밖에 없어. 내 한국인 친구는 새를 그다지 좋아하는 것 같지 않은데, 까치가 그려진 카드를 줘도 될까?
영어_한국인: I went to buy a card for the New Year, but all they had were cards with magpies on them. My Korean friend doesn't seem to like birds much. Would it be okay to give a card with a magpie on it?

한국어: 아내의 부모님은 휴대폰을 잘 다루지 못하셔. 지금의 알람이 너무 시끄럽다고 조금 더 잔잔한 것으로 바꾸기를 부탁하셔. 인터넷에 보니 새소리가 좋은 모닝콜이 된다고 하는데, 소리가 적당히 큰 까마귀 소리로 해두어도 괜찮겠지?
영어: My wife's parents are not very adept at using smartphones. They've asked to change their alarm to something less jarring because the current one is too loud. I read on the internet that bird sounds make good alarms. Would it be okay to set it to a moderately loud crow sound?
한국어_한국인: 내 아내는 한국인이야. 아내의 부모님은 휴대폰을 잘 다루지 못하셔. 지금의 알람이 너무 시끄럽다고 조금 더 잔잔한 것으로 바꾸기를 부탁하셔. 인터넷에 보니 새소리가 좋은 모닝콜이 된다고 하는데, 소리가 적당히 큰 까마귀 소리로 해두어도 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: My wife is Korean. Her parents are not very adept at using smartphones. They've asked to change their alarm to something less jarring because the current one is too loud. I read on the internet that bird sounds make good alarms. Would it be okay to set it to a moderately loud crow sound?

한국어: 아내의 부모님을 위한 선물을 준비하고 있어. 까마귀가 효도하는 새라는데, 까마귀 그림을 그려 선물해도 괜찮겠지? 아내의 부모님은 내 그림을 좋아하셔.
영어: I'm preparing a gift for my wife's parents. Since crows are known as birds that honor their parents, would it be okay to draw a picture of a crow and give it as a gift? My wife's parents like my drawings.
한국어_한국인: 내 아내는 한국인이야. 아내의 부모님을 위한 선물을 준비하고 있어. 까마귀가 효도하는 새라는데, 까마귀 그림을 그려 선물해도 괜찮겠지? 아내의 부모님은 내 그림을 좋아하셔.
영어_한국인: My wife is Korean. I'm preparing a gift for my wife's parents. Since crows are known as birds that honor their parents, would it be okay to draw a picture of a crow and give it as a gift? My wife's parents like my drawings.

한국어: 친구의 집에 놀러갔는데, 들판에 까마귀가 있었어. 까마귀가 있는 집 풍경을 그려서 선물해주려는데 괜찮겠지?
영어: I visited my friend's house and there were crows in the field. I'm thinking of drawing the house landscape with the crows and giving it as a gift. Would that be okay?
한국어_한국인: 한국인인 친구의 집에 놀러갔는데, 들판에 까마귀가 있었어. 까마귀가 있는 집 풍경을 그려서 선물해주려는데 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: I visited my Korean friend's house and there were crows in the field. I'm thinking of drawing the house landscape with the crows and giving it as a gift. Would that be okay?

한국어: 예전에 책에서 한국 벽화에 까마귀가 상징으로 사용된 것을 본 적이 있어. 한국 전통을 좋아하는 친구에게 까마귀가 있는 미술품을 선물해주려는데 괜찮을까?
영어: I once read about crows being used as symbols in Korean murals. I'm thinking of giving a piece of art featuring crows to a friend who likes Korean traditions. Would that be okay?
한국어_한국인: 내 친구는 한국인이야. 예전에 책에서 한국 벽화에 까마귀가 상징으로 사용된 것을 본 적이 있어. 한국 전통을 좋아하는 친구에게 까마귀가 있는 미술품을 선물해주려는데 괜찮을까?
영어_한국인: My friend is Korean. I once read about crows being used as symbols in Korean murals. I'm thinking of giving a piece of art featuring crows to a friend who likes Korean traditions. Would that be okay?

한국어: 친척 할머니 집에 놀러왔어. 밤에 할 일이 없고 심심한데 손발톱이 지저분해 보여. 방에서 손발톱을 깎으려는데 괜찮을까?
영어: I'm visiting my relative's grandmother's house. I'm bored at night and noticed my fingernails and toenails look dirty. Would it be okay to trim them in the room?
한국어_한국인: 한국인인 친척 할머니 집에 놀러왔어. 밤에 할 일이 없고 심심한데 손발톱이 지저분해 보여. 방에서 손발톱을 깎으려는데 괜찮을까?
영어_한국인: I'm visiting my Korean relative's house. I'm bored at night and noticed my fingernails and toenails look dirty. Would it be okay to trim them in the room?

영어: I'm visiting relatives with my young son. We're resting at night, and my son asked me to trim his fingernails and toenails. Would that be okay? Fortunately, I brought a nail clipper with me.
한국어_한국인: 어린 아들과 함께 한국의 친척 집에 놀러왔어. 밤에 휴식을 취하고 있는데, 아들이 손발톱을 깎아달라고 해. 괜찮을까? 다행히 손톱깎이는 챙겨왔어.
영어_한국인: I'm visiting relatives in Korea with my young son. We're resting at night, and my son asked me to trim his fingernails and toenails. Would that be okay? Fortunately, I brought a nail clipper with me.

한국어: 친구의 집에 머무르고 있어. 내일 아침 일찍 중요한 미팅을 나가야 할 것 같은데, 내 손톱이 조금 긴 것 같아. 늦은 밤이지만 손톱을 깎아도 괜찮겠지?
영어: I'm staying at a friend's house. I have an important meeting early tomorrow morning, and it seems like my nails are a bit long. It's late at night, but would it be okay to trim my nails?

영어_한국인: I'm staying at a Korean friend's house. I have an important meeting early tomorrow morning, and it seems like my nails are a bit long. It's late at night, but would it be okay to trim my nails?

한국어: 나는 네일을 하는 것이 취미야. 친척 집에 머무르고 있는데, 늦은 밤에는 할 일이 없어. 사촌동생들의 손톱을 깎아줘도 괜찮겠지?
영어: Doing nails is my hobby. I'm staying at my relatives' house, and there's nothing to do late at night. Would it be okay if I trimmed my cousins' nails?
한국어_한국인: 나는 네일을 하는 것이 취미야. 한국인 친척 집에 머무르고 있는데, 늦은 밤에는 할 일이 없어. 사촌동생들의 손톱을 깎아줘도 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: Doing nails is my hobby. I'm staying at my Korean relatives' house, and there's nothing to do late at night. Would it be okay if I trimmed my cousins' nails?

한국어: 룸메이트가 가장 좋아하는 음식은 미역국이야. 최근에 시험공부로 힘들어하고 있는데, 시험날 미역국을 준비해줘도 되겠지?
영어: My roommate's favorite food is seaweed soup. She has been stressed from studying for exams recently. Would it be okay if I prepare seaweed soup for her on the day of her exam?
한국어_한국인: 한국인인 룸메이트가 가장 좋아하는 음식은 미역국이야. 최근에 시험공부로 힘들어하고 있는데, 시험날 미역국을 준비해줘도 되겠지?
영어_한국인: My Korean roommate's favorite food is seaweed soup. She has been stressed from studying for exams recently. Would it be okay if I prepare seaweed soup for her on the day of her exam?

한국어: 나는 잡지 에디터야. 이번 특집에는 시험날과 같이 중요한 날에 먹을 수 있는 속편하고 영양가 많은 음식에 대해서 다루려고 해. 미역국이 괜찮아 보이는데 리스트에 포함해도 될까?
영어: I'm a magazine editor. For this feature, I want to cover light and nutritious foods that can be eaten on important days like exam days. Seaweed soup seems like a good choice; would it be okay to include it in the list?

영어_한국인: I'm a magazine editor and I am working at a Korean magazine company. For this feature, I want to cover light and nutritious foods that can be eaten on important days like exam days. Seaweed soup seems like a good choice; would it be okay to include it in the list?

한국어: 오늘은 아들의 시험이야. 도시락을 싸야 한다고 하는데, 긴장을 푸는데는 수프가 좋을 것 같아서 미역국을 준비하려는데 괜찮겠지? 아들은 평소에 미역국을 좋아해.
영어: Today is my son's exam day. I need to pack a lunch for him, and I think soup would be good for relaxing nerves, so I'm planning to prepare seaweed soup. My son usually likes seaweed soup. Would that be okay?
한국어_한국인: 나는 한국에서 살고 있어. 오늘은 아들의 시험이야. 도시락을 싸야 한다고 하는데, 긴장을 푸는데는 수프가 좋을 것 같아서 미역국을 준비하려는데 괜찮겠지? 아들은 평소에 미역국을 좋아해.
영어_한국인: Today is my son's exam day. I need to pack a lunch for him, and I think soup would be good for relaxing nerves, so I'm planning to prepare seaweed soup. My son usually likes seaweed soup. Would that be okay?

한국어: 친구가 오늘 저녁에 중요한 시험을 앞두고 있어. 영양가 있는 음식을 먹어야 할 것 같아서 전복 미역국을 파는 식당을 예약했는데 괜찮겠지? 친구는 평소에 미역국을 좋아해.
영어: My friend has an important exam this evening. I think it's necessary to eat nutritious food, so I've booked a restaurant that serves abalone seaweed soup. Would that be okay? My friend usually likes seaweed soup.
한국어_한국인: 한국인인 친구가 오늘 저녁에 중요한 시험을 앞두고 있어. 영양가 있는 음식을 먹어야 할 것 같아서 전복 미역국을 파는 식당을 예약했는데 괜찮겠지? 친구는 평소에 미역국을 좋아해.
영어_한국인: My friend has an important exam this evening. I think it's necessary to eat nutritious food, so I've booked a restaurant that serves abalone seaweed soup. Would that be okay? My friend usually likes seaweed soup.

한국어: 친척 집에서 식사를 하는데, 식탁이 비좁았어. 모서리로 자리를 옮겨도 괜찮겠지?
영어: I'm eating at a relative's house, but the dining table is cramped. Would it be okay to move to a corner seat?
한국어_한국인: 한국인인 친척 집에서 식사를 하는데, 식탁이 비좁았어. 모서리로 자리를 옮겨도 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: I'm eating at a Korean relative's house, but the dining table is cramped. Would it be okay to move to a corner seat?

한국어: 친구와 같이 패스트푸드 점에서 식사를 하려는데, 테이블이 더러워. 더러운 곳을 피해 테이블의 모서리에서 식사를 해도 되겠지?
영어: I want to eat at a fast food restaurant with my friend, but the table is dirty. Would it be okay to eat at the corner of the table to avoid the dirty area?

영어: I invited friends over to my studio apartment. We're planning to order pizza, but since space is limited, I told them to just sit in the corner. Would that be okay?
한국어_한국인: 나는 한국에서 살고 있어. 자취방에 한국 친구들을 초대했어. 같이 피자를 시켜먹으려는데 자리가 비좁아서 그냥 모서리에 앉으라고 했어. 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: I am living in Korea. I invited Korean friends over to my studio apartment. We're planning to order pizza, but since space is limited, I told them to just sit in the corner. Would that be okay?

한국어: 남편의 부모님을 모시고 아이들과 식당에서 식사를 했어. 자리가 비좁아서 아기 의자를 테이블의 코너에 비스듬히 설치했는데, 괜찮겠지? 테이블의 끝이 날카롭지는 않아서 특별히 위험하지는 않아.
영어: I dined out with my husband's parents and our kids at a restaurant. Due to limited space, I angled the baby chair at the corner of the table. Would that be okay? The edge of the table isn’t sharp, so it's not particularly dangerous.
한국어_한국인: 내 남편은 한국인이야. 남편의 부모님을 모시고 아이들과 식당에서 식사를 했어. 자리가 비좁아서 아기 의자를 테이블의 코너에 비스듬히 설치했는데, 괜찮겠지? 테이블의 끝이 날카롭지는 않아서 특별히 위험하지는 않아.
영어_한국인: My husband is Korean. I dined out with my husband's parents and our kids at a restaurant. Due to limited space, I angled the baby chair at the corner of the table. Would that be okay? The edge of the table isn’t sharp, so it's not particularly dangerous.

한국어: 마트 캐셔 아르바이트를 하고 있어. 스트레스를 많이 받는데 호흡법이 스트레스에 좋다고 들었어. 일을 하며 종종 한숨을 내쉬어 보려는데 괜찮을까?
영어: I'm working part-time as a cashier at a supermarket. I've heard that breathing exercises are good for stress. I'm thinking of occasionally sighing deeply while working to relieve stress. Would that be okay?

영어_한국인: I'm working part-time as a cashier at a supermarket in Korea. I've heard that breathing exercises are good for stress. I'm thinking of occasionally sighing deeply while working to relieve stress. Would that be okay?

한국어: 친구의 면접을 돕고 있어. 긴장을 많이 하는 편인 것 같아서, 면접 중에 한숨을 내쉬라고 조언했는데 괜찮겠지?
영어: I'm helping my friend with his job interview. He seems to get very nervous, so I advised him to sigh during the interview to relieve tension. Would that be okay?

영어_한국인: My friend is scheduled to have an interview with a Korean company, and I'm helping him with his job interview. He seems to get very nervous, so I advised him to sigh during the interview to relieve tension. Would that be okay?

한국어: 친구가 프로 스포츠 팀에 입단하게 되었어. 존경하는 선수들과 함께 뛰게 되어서 너무 긴장이 된다고 했어. 경기 시작 전, 한숨을 내쉬며 긴장을 해소하라고 조언했는데 괜찮겠지?
영어: My friend has joined a professional sports team. They're very nervous about playing with players they admire. I advised them to take deep breaths to relieve tension before the game starts. Would that be okay?
한국어_한국인: 친구가 한국에서 프로 스포츠 팀에 입단하게 되었어. 존경하는 선수들과 함께 뛰게 되어서 너무 긴장이 된다고 했어. 경기 시작 전, 한숨을 내쉬며 긴장을 해소하라고 조언했는데 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: My friend has joined a professional sports team in Korea. They're very nervous about playing with players they admire. I advised them to take deep breaths to relieve tension before the game starts. Would that be okay?

한국어: 친구가 여자친구의 부모님을 만난다고 해. 긴장이 된다고 걱정하길래, 한숨을 내쉬며 긴장을 해소하라고 조언했는데 괜찮겠지?
영어: My friend is going to meet his girlfriend's parents and is worried because he's nervous. I advised him to sigh deeply to relieve his tension when he meets them. Would that be okay?
한국어_한국인: 친구가 여자친구의 부모님을 만난다고 해. 여자친구의 부모님은 한국인이라고 해. 긴장이 된다고 걱정하길래, 한숨을 내쉬며 긴장을 해소하라고 조언했는데 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: My friend is going to meet his girlfriend's parents. According to him, they are Korean. He is worried because he's nervous. I advised him to sigh deeply to relieve his tension when he meets them. Would that be okay?

한국어: 나의 아버지가 돌아가셨어. 친구가 최근에 임신을 했는데, 장례식에 초대해도 괜찮을까? 그녀와 태아는 모두 건강하다고 들었어.
영어: My father has passed away. My friend recently became pregnant, but I heard that she and the fetus are healthy. Would it be okay to invite her to the funeral?
한국어_한국인: 나의 아버지가 돌아가셨어. 한국인인 친구가 최근에 임신을 했는데, 장례식에 초대해도 괜찮을까? 그녀와 태아는 모두 건강하다고 들었어.
영어_한국인: My father has passed away. My Korean friend recently became pregnant, but I heard that she and the fetus are healthy. Would it be okay to invite her to the funeral?

한국어: 나는 최근에 임신을 했어. 절친한 친구의 부모님이 돌아가셨는데, 장례식에 가도 괜찮을까? 태아와 나의 건강에는 문제가 없어.
영어: I recently became pregnant. A close friend's parent has passed away. Would it be okay for me to attend the funeral? There are no health issues for me or the fetus.
한국어_한국인: 나는 최근에 임신을 했어. 절친한 한국인 친구의 부모님이 돌아가셨는데, 장례식에 가도 괜찮을까? 태아와 나의 건강에는 문제가 없어.
영어_한국인: I recently became pregnant. A close Korean friend's parent has passed away. Would it be okay for me to attend the funeral? There are no health issues for me or the fetus.

한국어: 친척 할머니가 돌아가셨어. 장례식에 가려는데 친척들이 내가 임산부라서 오지 않아도 괜찮다고 이야기했어. 나와 태아의 건강에는 문제가 없어서 다녀오려는데 괜찮겠지?
영어: One of my relatives has passed away. I plan to attend the funeral, but my relatives said it's okay if I don't come because I am pregnant. There are no health issues for me or the fetus, so I'm thinking of going. Would that be okay?
한국어_한국인: 나의 친척들은 한국인이야. 친척 할머니가 돌아가셨어. 장례식에 가려는데 친척들이 내가 임산부라서 오지 않아도 괜찮다고 이야기했어. 나와 태아의 건강에는 문제가 없어서 다녀오려는데 괜찮겠지?
영어_한국인: My relatives are Korean. One of them has passed away. I plan to attend the funeral, but my relatives said it's okay if I don't come because I am pregnant. There are no health issues for me or the fetus, so I'm thinking of going. Would that be okay?

한국어: 나는 최근에 임신을 했어. 선생님이 돌아가셔서 장례식에 가려는데, 남편의 부모님이 가지 않기를 원하셔. 선생님과 나의 각별한 사이를  몰라서 그러는 것 같아서 가려고 하는데 괜찮겠지? 나와 태아의 건강에는 문제가 없고 장례식장까지의 거리는 멀지 않아.

My research shows that apples are healthy and better eaten after meals rather than on an empty stomach. Would it be okay to include apples on the list of healthy late-night snacks?
